verdict.rationale: First-party docs and the GitHub README describe suspending an agent or workflow to await user input or approval. Execution state is persisted to storage, so a run can pause indefinitely and resume where it left off (mastra-gh-4, mastra-docs-39). Workflows expose suspend()/resume() for human-in-the-loop input and can resume or bail based on that input (mastra-docs-12, mastra-docs-53, mastra-docs-40). Agent tools can be marked requireApproval: true and approved or declined via a tool-call-approval stream chunk (mastra-docs-31). Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that pause/resume and approval work in practice.
